ambient_events: The drain gurgles once and settles.
Linen is refolded on the bench by somebody who has folded a great deal of linen.
The door at the far end doesn't open. You hadn't asked it to.
description: Single storey, thick-walled, no windows facing the road. A drum stands outside the door on a pallet with a lid strapped down on it, and the drum is the only thing in the compound that anybody has bothered to chain to anything.
name: The Stillhouse
